raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  librapidyaml_version: "0.15.0"
  rapidyaml_version: "0.15.0"

recipe:
  name: rapidyaml
  version: ${{ librapidyaml_version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/biojppm/rapidyaml/releases/download/v${{ librapidyaml_version }}/rapidyaml-${{ librapidyaml_version }}-src.tgz
  sha256: 02b6f99c72315b8d20b1aa47f4e941e80069d9edd5bae4ba2fdf7e83d8f52d34

build:
  number: 1

outputs:
  - package:
      name: librapidyaml
      version: ${{ librapidyaml_version }}
    build:
      script:
        - if: win
          then: |
            mkdir build
            cd build
            cmake -G "Ninja" ^
                -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release ^
                -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=%LIBRARY_PREFIX% ^
                -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=ON ^
                -DRYML_BUILD_TESTS=OFF ^
                -DRYML_BUILD_BENCHMARKS=OFF ^
                -DRYML_BUILD_TOOLS=OFF ^
                -DRYML_BUILD_API=OFF ^
                %SRC_DIR%
            cmake --build . --target install
        - if: unix
          then: |
            mkdir -p build
            cd build
            cmake ${CMAKE_ARGS} \
                -GNinja \
                -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
                -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$PREFIX \
                -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=ON \
                -DRYML_BUILD_TESTS=OFF \
                -DRYML_BUILD_BENCHMARKS=OFF \
                -DRYML_BUILD_TOOLS=OFF \
                -DRYML_BUILD_API=OFF \
                $SRC_DIR
            cmake --build . --target install

    requirements:
      run_exports:
        # Pre-1.0 version; breaking changes can occur in any release
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("librapidyaml", upper_bound="x.x.x") }}
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - cmake
        - ninja

    tests:
      - package_contents:
          include:
            - ryml.hpp
            - ryml_std.hpp
          lib:
            - ryml


  - package:
      name: rapidyaml
      version: ${{ rapidyaml_version }}
    about:
      homepage: https://github.com/biojppm/rapidyaml-python
      license: MIT
      license_file: LICENSE.txt
      summary: Python bindings for RapidYAML, a fast C++ YAML parser
      description: |
        Python bindings for RapidYAML (ryml), a fast C++ YAML parser and
        emitter. The bindings are maintained in a dedicated repository and
        link against the librapidyaml shared library.
      documentation: https://github.com/biojppm/rapidyaml-python/blob/master/README.md
      repository: https://github.com/biojppm/rapidyaml-python
    source:
      # put the source code into separate target directory to avoid clashes of cpp files with librapidyaml source
      - url: https://github.com/biojppm/rapidyaml-python/archive/refs/tags/v${{ rapidyaml_version }}.tar.gz
        sha256: ca0d7fee78e54b3e87f809f7952df464ecccf28511ea66685eb43bc468b968fb
        target_directory: rapidyaml-python
      # fetch cpp source and put it where the python course expects a git submodule
      - url: https://github.com/biojppm/rapidyaml/releases/download/v${{ rapidyaml_version }}/rapidyaml-${{ rapidyaml_version }}-src.tgz
        sha256: 02b6f99c72315b8d20b1aa47f4e941e80069d9edd5bae4ba2fdf7e83d8f52d34
        target_directory: rapidyaml-python/cpp
        patches:
          # The python API only builds an extension module, but on macOS the
          # full Development component was requested, which implies
          # Development.Embed and so needs a shared libpython. conda-forge
          # stopped shipping that alongside the interpreter in CPython 3.15
          # (conda-forge/python-feedstock#843), breaking the osx builds while
          # every other platform, already on Development.Module, was fine.
          # Not yet reported upstream; still present on master.
          - patches/0001-api-dont-require-Development.Embed-for-the-python-module.patch
    build:
      script:
        env:
          SETUPTOOLS_SCM_PRETEND_VERSION: ${{ rapidyaml_version }}
        content:
          - if: unix
            then: $PYTHON -m pip install ./rapidyaml-python -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
          - if: win
            then: |
              %PYTHON% -m pip install .\rapidyaml-python -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - cmake
        - ninja
        - swig
      host:
        - python
        - pip
        - setuptools
        - setuptools-scm
        - cmake-build-extension
      run:
        - python
        - deprecation
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - ryml
          pip_check: true



about:
  homepage: https://github.com/biojppm/rapidyaml
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE.txt
  summary: A C++ library to parse and emit YAML, and do it fast
  description: |
    RapidYAML (ryml) is a C++ library to parse and emit YAML, with focus
    on speed and minimal memory overhead. It features in-place parsing,
    string views instead of copies, and a flat index-based tree structure.
    It achieves approximately 150MB/s YAML parsing and 450MB/s JSON parsing
    on modern processors, significantly outperforming alternatives.
  documentation: https://github.com/biojppm/rapidyaml/blob/master/README.md
  repository: https://github.com/biojppm/rapidyaml

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - alessandrofelder
    - chrisburr

  feedstock-name: rapidyaml
